inputs.description: ESP32 hostname or IP (e.g. esp32.local or 192.168.0.180)

tasks.label: ESP-IDF: Build & Wireless OTA Upload
tasks.command: if [ -f "$HOME/.espressif/tools/activate_idf_v6.0.2.sh" ]; then . "$HOME/.espressif/tools/activate_idf_v6.0.2.sh"; elif [ -f "$HOME/esp/esp-idf/export.sh" ]; then . "$HOME/esp/esp-idf/export.sh"; else echo 'ESP-IDF activation script not found'; exit 1; fi; idf.py build && curl -f --max-time 180 -H 'Expect:' -X POST --data-binary @build/wifi_ota_monitor.bin "http://${input:espHost}/update"

windows.command: . 'C:\Espressif\tools\Microsoft.v6.0.2.PowerShell_profile.ps1'; idf.py build; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { curl.exe -f --max-time 180 -H 'Expect:' -X POST --data-binary '@build/wifi_ota_monitor.bin' "http://${input:espHost}/update" } else { exit 1 }

tasks.label: ESP-IDF: Wireless Serial Monitor
tasks.command: while true; do nc "${input:espHost}" 3333; echo 'Waiting for device...'; sleep 2; done

windows.command: while ($true) { try { $c = New-Object System.Net.Sockets.TcpClient; $c.Connect('${input:espHost}', 3333); $r = New-Object System.IO.StreamReader($c.GetStream()); while (($l = $r.ReadLine()) -ne $null) { Write-Host $l } } catch { Write-Host "Waiting for device... $($_.Exception.Message)" } finally { if ($c) { $c.Close() } }; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2 }
